description: Defines the minimal canonical grammar for TriadicFrameworks, including operators, structural primitives, regime markers, dimensional transitions, and cross-module propagation rules.
purpose: Provide the authoritative grammar substrate for all modules, ensuring zero drift, consistent operator semantics, and student-accessible definitions.

sections.title: Operators
sections.summary: Defines the canonical operator grammar used across all modules, including triadic operators, regime operators, and coherence operators.

sections.title: Dimensional Primitives
sections.summary: Lists the base dimensional constructs used for RTT, paradox analysis, and substrate modeling.

sections.title: Regime Markers
sections.summary: Defines the markers that indicate transitions between light, causal, paradox, and coherence regimes.

sections.title: Coherence Rules
sections.summary: Specifies the rules that maintain cross-module coherence and prevent drift.

sections.title: Cross-Module Propagation
sections.summary: Describes how grammar elements propagate across modules and how lineage is maintained.

ai_metadata.ai.purpose: Provide the minimal canonical grammar for all TriadicFrameworks modules.
